programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. The brave little battler needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has travelled to the Cook Island to help out at a busy vet clinic in the capital Rarotonga. His first patient is Princess, a hit run victim. Chris quickly finds out just how tough it is looking after the local pets, with only basic facilities and limited supplies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing. Chris is immediately concerned that Small One may have a skin cancer.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris makes a special trip to Karara in Queensland to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris travels to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne, where he is faced with a very woolly fugitive. Ben Hall is a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick, matted wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is visiting remote Christmas Island where he has to help a seabird named Bill that is unable to fly. Bill is a rare Abbott’s Booby, and she's missing critical flight feathers. Chris needs to treat Bill's deformed wing, before starting rehabilitation with the young rescue bird.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tim wants Chris to find out why Jack the koala has suddenly developed nasty bumps all over his face. Chris is so concerned, they take the little 2 year old to the local clinic for an immediate biopsy. When the results come back Tim is astonished to learn that Jack has acne.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A dairy buffalo called Penny has severely deformed horns, which are growing into her skull, dangerously close to her brain. Chris has to try to corral the timid 10 year old, and then carry out the painstaking job of carefully removing the horns.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is heading out to sea, to help try to save an endangered Grey Nurse shark, which has been spotted entangled in fishing line and with a hook stuck in its mouth. A specialist rescue team has been assembled and Chris is joining them in the water, to try to corral the injured shark so it can be brought to the surface.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns. His first patient is a young dog which has had a nasty encounter with a hedgecutter. Misty has ended up with deep cuts across her nose. How the young dog avoided more disastrous injuries is a miracle.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns, and his first patient is a rare Fijian iguana Called Ako. The Iguana hasn't been himself, and isn't eating properly. Chris needs to do an x-ray to try to work out what's going on. The results reveal a massive bladder stone inside the small animal, and he needs immediate surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A little joey has been brought in to Chris at the Bondi clinic after its mother was hit and killed by a car. It's feared the frail orphan may have a broken leg, but carer Sandy is determined to give the little battler a chance. It's a huge challenge for Chris to try to repair the leg. It's a heart stopping moment when he finds if the risky surgery has been a success.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: BENDIGO Bendigo was one of the biggest gold finds in history. it’s literally built on rivers of gold. Her grand hotels and theatres have played host to international celebrities… and some shady characters too.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: NEWCASTLE Like it's English namesake, Australia’s Newcastle also has a reputation for toughness and heavy toil, but it’s also a town with a unique identity, a rich maritime history and more than its share of eccentric characters.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: CARLTON Well known as the headquarters for generations of crime bosses, Carlton was also the epicentre to a creative outpouring in the 1960s and 70s that lead to the emergence of a uniquely Australian film and theatre culture.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: BRISBANE In 1941 sleepy tropical Brisbane found itself the nerve centre for the Pacific War effort. The former convict colony found itself changing quickly, yet politically Queensland is the most conservative state in Australia.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: ST KILDA Once a seaside retreat for 19 Century yuppies, later a suburb defined by the heroin addicts who flocked there, St Kilda has endured a constant cycle of boom and bust – Today it is again one of Melbourne’s most desired addresses.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: ADELAIDE City of Churches it may be but Adelaide has always been a strange mix of progressive politics and small town parochialism. Adelaide has had its share of drama too.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks

programme.title: Wild Dolphins
programme.desc: In the waters surrounding New Zealand live a number of dolphin species - each of which has evolved unique strategies in their family pods to survive and thrive in the different habitats around these islands in the Pacific Ocean. On the east coast of the south island off the iconic Kaikoura peninsula, an underwater canyon pushes water seething with nutrients to the surface which provides a year round banquet for huge pods of dusky dolphins. These athletic and highly social dolphins spend their nights feeding out in the canyon, and in early morning they return closer to shore where they rest socialize and play. One of their favourite activities is the “seaweed game” where individuals pass pieces of seaweed to each other practicing fancy maneuvers where they’ll catch it on their tail, dorsal or pectoral fins. Down in the south west corner of New Zealand in the majestic landscape of Fiordland live the southern-most bottlenose dolphins. At almost 4 metres long these dolphins have adapted physically to the extreme winter conditions down here by growing bigger and fatter with extra insulating blubber and evolving stubbier beaks and shorter fins and tail flukes to reduce heat loss through their extremities. These fiords are different to the coastal environment in that freshwater sits on top of the denser seawater in a distinct layer, and is much colder than the saltwater and can prove lethal to the pods’ calves in winter, so every year the bottlenose dolphins make a short migration to the outer fiords where there is less freshwater to enable their calves to survive. Off New Zealand’s north island, in the middle of the Bay of Plenty, the country’s most active volcano erupts from the sea, sending plumes of toxic gases rising skywards. In the water surrounding this volcano roam common dolphins - the nomads of the dolphin world. They are pelagic predators which mean they roam the open ocean searching for prey.

programme.title: Eagle Queen of the Skies
programme.desc: Eagles are top predators who battle fiercely for survival and work hard to raise their young. There are 60 members of the eagle clan, all united by their acute eyesight, powerful wings, sharp talons and hooked beaks. To explore the world of the eagle we follow one individual from hatching to leaving the nest and setting up a home. Her fight for survival reveals what it takes to become a queen of the sky.

programme.title: Eagle Lakes

With more than 470 square kilometres, it is the third largest natural reserve in Schleswig-Holstein. Due to its extensive forest areas, 40 lakes and its proximity to Mecklenburg’s biosphere reserve Lake Schalsee, it forms the largest protectoral area alongside the former inner-German border.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Human life today would be very different if our ancestors had not stopped hunting animal protein. In the Fertile Crescent - known today as the Middle East - humans travelled in nomadic groups of hunter-gatherers and ate what they killed.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: When our ancestors saw how other animals kept warm in sub-freezing temperatures, they started hunting them for their hides and fur. As hominid evolution was diverging from other primates, they lost their thick covering of fur when the mercury dropped.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: About twelve thousand years ago, before the Neolithic Revolution, humans were mainly hunter-gatherers. Among the animals we hunted were the wild aurochs, the ancestor of all domestic cattle. The domestication of cows led to the use of oxen as draught animals that could help farmers plough fields.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: Throughout history, humans have surrounded themselves with animals. But there are two species that are our undeniable favourites. Every dog today was once a wolf - genetically speaking. Wolves and hominids met as early as 400,000 years ago. Ancient hunter-gatherers and wolves competed for the same prey, and used the same tracking techniques.

programme.title: Big is beautiful
programme.desc: The world is full of giants, huge creatures that fill us with awe and wonder. Some are gentle giants. Others are deadly hunters. There are different ways of defining ‘big’ - biggest in volume, or the biggest of their kind. But one thing is for sure, the huge animals of this world are fascinating, diverse and beautiful.

programme.title: Sharks of the Icy North
programme.desc: We mostly know the nimble predators from the depths of tropical seas. At the same time very little is known about the sharks of the icy North.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: For most of our history, people have fallen victim to crippling disease, and not had a clue where it came from. Despite our best efforts, we are vulnerable - not, perhaps, to lions, tigers, and bears - but more to the killers we can’t even see. In America during the early 1980s, a mysterious new disease claims the lives of 159 people, most of them gay men.

programme.title: Animals That Changed History - Season 1
programme.desc: As a species, we believe we are more than just animals. We are inspired to express ourselves through words, art, music, and scientific endeavours. Our ancestors painted animals on cave walls - usually large mammals, like bison and deer. Animals were out first artistic subject, our first inspiration.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe's history has many dark sides, but its culture is more than a small gleam of hope, it radiates in many areas far out into the world. The old continent sets standards in art, literature and science. Starting with the ancient Greeks, Europe produces a number of smart and creative minds: from Aristotle to Michelangelo and Einstein, from Beethoven to the Beatles.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has been a battle concept for centuries: it often takes foreign enemies to weld the Europeans together. But for centuries, they are primarily fighting against themselves. It was not until the Enlightenment and the French Revolution of 1789 that a new idea of Europe emerged based on common values: freedom, equality and fraternalism.

programme.title: The Story of Europe
programme.desc: Europe has never experienced such a long period of peace and prosperity as after the Second World War. When the Iron Curtain falls in 1989, the dream of a Europe united in peace and freedom seems finally to become reality. But whether financial or refugee crisis - the European euphoria has disappeared, nationalists are on the rise again.

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It’s the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there’s more than just the act - it’s the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal’s purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy.

programme.title: St Agatha
programme.desc: St Agatha is a twisted horror thriller which pushes the boundaries of the nunsploitation genre from Darren Lynn Bousman, the director of Saw II, III and IV. In 1950s Georgia, a pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side. Enter this convent at your own risk!

programme.title: Discarnate
programme.desc: The producer of Independence Day: Resurgence brings you this spine-tingling descent into the supernatural. A grieving neuro-scientist creates a mind-altering serum that reconnects people to the other side. However it unknowingly attracts a more sinister being. This mind-bending horror stars Thomas Kretschmann (King Kong) Josh Stewart (Interstellar) and Bex Taylor-Klaus (TVs Scream).

programme.title: Let Go
programme.desc: Featuring the king of comedy Kevin Hart, this hilarious, unconventional and heartfelt journey is all about love, loss and other felonies! Discontent parole officer Walter is struggling with the humdrums of married life, when three troublesome ex-cons are placed under his supervision. Little does Walter know that these eccentric strangers are the inspiration he was looking for!

programme.title: Valhalla: Legend of Thor
programme.desc: No man, woman or child may defy the gods. When Thor and Loki seek refuge in the home of mortals, the youngest son fails to heed a warning from the gods. As atonement for the family's sins, the gods take the two youngest children under their wing and embark on an epic adventure from Midgard to Valhalla that will see them stare down ruthless giants, barbaric gods and the dreaded wolf Fenrir.

programme.title: A Call to Spy
programme.desc: Inspired by incredible true stories. At the beginning of WWII Churchill orders his new spy agency to recruit women as spies to build a resistance. SOEs spymistress Vera Atkins (Stana Katic), recruits Virginia Hall (Sarah Megan Thomas), an ambitious American with a wooden leg and Noor Inayat Khan (Radhika Apte), a Muslim pacifist, who leave an unmistakable legacy in their wake.

programme.title: Slightly Single in LA
programme.desc: Fun, flirty and downright outrageous. Independent, LA singleton Dale (Lacey Chabert, Mean Girls) is sick and tired of her troublesome love life. On the verge of giving up, she is reunited with an old friend - successful heartthrob and rock star Zach. Is this Dale's lucky chance to fall in love? Also starring Jenna Dewan (Step Up) and Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls). Perfect for a girls night in!

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate battle between robots and mankind! When teenager Sean (Callan McAuliffe: The Great Gatsby) sets out to join the Resistance, against the robots, the fate of the world lies in his hands. Hot on his heels however, is robot collaborator Mr. Smythe (Ben Kingsley: Iron Man 3). This exhilarating British sci-fi thriller, delivers a bombastic robot takeover that is not to be missed!

programme.title: The Beat Beneath my Feet
programme.desc: With a School of Rock-esque vibe, this hilarious coming-of-age tale explores unconventional friendship in the most riotous way. When nerdy teen Tom meets rebellious American rock legend Max (Luke Perry), he knows this is his chance to fulfil his dreams. Tom agrees not to report the 'presumed dead' Max to the authorities...on the basis that he teaches him how to play guitar.

programme.title: Witch Hunt
programme.desc: Hunted. Persecuted. Executed. The witch trials come to life in modern day America. Claire (Gideon Adlon - The Craft: Legacy) and her mother (Elizabeth Mitchell - The Expanse) are part of an underground movement that ferries women accused of witchcraft to safety. All is well until a new charge brings the witch hunters to their door. Will they also be charged with the ungodly crime of being a witch?

programme.title: The Wicker Man
programme.desc: Based on the hit thriller of the same name and starring Nicolas Cage, this cult classic returns 15 years after its original release. A man finds himself sucked into a twisted community whose secrets and Puritan ways could see a young girl sacrificed. It’s a race against time for this outsider to save a life but the residents of Summers Isle may just have other plans.

programme.title: The Hatton Garden Job
programme.desc: A remarkable true story of the largest heist in English legal history. Four ageing East End criminals led by 76 year-old Brian Reader (Larry Lamb) drill into a steel-and-concrete secured safety deposit vault in Londons Hatton Garden jewellery quarter. With everyone from the Hungarian mob to Scotland Yard on their tail, will they commit the crime of the century or pay with their lives?

programme.title: An Affair
programme.desc: Leading a picture-perfect life with her husband, Anita starts a new job as a PE teacher. But her life takes a dramatic turn when she falls prey to Markus, an obsessive student. As time goes on, the encounters leads to an unthinkable and secret affair. Soon their bond turns dubious, tensions rise and things begin to drastically spiral. A superbly-crafted and taut erotic edge-of-your-seat thriller!

programme.title: Just Before I Go
programme.desc: Courteney Cox (Friends) directs this hysterical comedy drama starring Seann William Scott (American Pie) and Kate Walsh (The Perks of being a Wallflower). In an effort to move on, disgruntled 41-year-old divorcee Ted Morgan travels back to his hometown to face the people who have made him the man he is today. But little does he know, he has the chance to find new hope and love!

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: Young Army officer John Mullan heads west to help establish an important wagon route through the Northern Rockies. But, before he can build his road, Mullan must survive the hardships of the frontier and a dangerous encounter with Yakima warriors.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: The cowboys are busy processing cattle and preparing for an important shipment when a chute gets stuck, bringing work to a halt and risking time and money they can't afford to lose. Booger trains a cutting horse and enters it into its first competition. Cody organizes a campout for the youth at the Alabama Sheriff's Boys Ranch, and the guys share some of their cowboy wisdom with the hope of inspiring another generation to follow the cowboy way. Friends and family gather for a baby shower, where Bubba and Kaley reveal the name they've chosen for their new addition.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: During a long drought in lower Alabama, the cowboys have been chasing green grass throughout the surrounding area. Through new partnerships with other ranchers, they've finally ended up with a bumper crop of calves in north Alabama and a healthy herd in south Florida. Cody and Misty seek out the perfect high-value bull to build their growing cattle business, and they watch as their dream home finally takes shape. Bubba and Kaley welcome baby Ripp Walker Thompson into the world. Booger and Jaclyn surprise Grandma with a cowboy cookbook filled with her recipes and stories from life on the range.

programme.title: Handcrafted America
programme.desc: Host Jill Wagner travels the country on a quest to find talented craftsmen who still make incredible items by hand. First, Jill is shocked by how Detroit woodworker, Paul Bonenberger uses electric current to "paint" his one-of-kind Lichtenberg etched light fixtures. In the Chesapeake Bay area of Maryland, commercial airline pilot Tom Gaunnt scours the local beaches for driftwood that he infuses with sea glass colored resin to make his distinctive beach inspired ink pens. Down in Charleston, South Carolina, award- winning milliner Natalie Simmons is off to the races making her Kentucky Derby style sinamy hats with handmade floral accents.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: What does American Idol winner Taylor Hicks do when he's not touring the country singing and entertaining? He goes back on the road, only this time it's to seek out the America's most delicious foods - state by state! So let's hear it for some Georgia pride! Because this week, Taylor tastes his way across Georgia on a quest to sample the state's most emblematic foods. With the help of iconic actress Maureen McCormick, Taylor uncovers the stories behind Georgia's traditional southern dishes. Join Taylor as he hauls in boatloads of shrimp at a seaside dock, and Maureen learns how to mill corn into grits. They also sample boiled peanuts at a roadside stand and discover why Georgia onions are among the sweetest in the country. For a perfect ending, they visit a pecan orchard for pecan pie and a peach orchard for peach ice cream.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Little Joe's friend, Dolly Kincaid, daughter of the town sheriff, is always falling in with the wrong kind. She becomes involved with Vince Dagen and soon finds out he is an outlaw. It's up to Joe to try and save her.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When Black cowboy Nat Love overnights in Deadwood during a cattle drive, he decides to enter a Fourth of July cowboy competition. Confident in his roping, riding, and shooting skills, he is eager to test his mettle against the best cowboys around.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When homesteaders keep cutting down her fences to access grazing land and water, a widowed landowner teams up with famed Texas Ranger Ira Aten to protect her property. Aten hopes his explosive plan of action will force the cutters to compromise.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: With dreams of fortune and adventure, an 18-year-old Jim Bridger joins William Ashley's expedition to trap beaver along the Missouri River. But a grim ordeal soon forces Bridger to weigh his morals against the harsh reality of survival in the wild. A vicious grizzly bear attack leaves fellow trapper and hunter Hugh Glass on the verge of death and completely dependent upon Bridger's care. As a hostile band of Arikara warriors begins to close in, Bridger must choose between staying with the dying man and risking certain death, or leaving his injured comrade alone in the woods and fleeing to safety. In what becomes a legendary tale of the wild frontier, Bridger wrestles to choose between right and wrong, knowing the harsh retribution that will follow if he makes the wrong choice.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: World champion tie-down roper, Fred Whitfield, joins Trace Adkins to judge the cowboys as they compete in an individual calf-roping challenge. The contestant who ropes the fastest time wins immunity from the next elimination. Tensions continue to build between two of the competitors until one reaches his breaking point, and things get physical. A team challenge puts the cowboys' skills to the test. Trace wonders if some of them have the experience needed to compete at this level. The two contestants who fall short hit the trail, leaving eight cowboys remaining.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way
programme.desc: The cowboys head west to Louisiana in this episode of The Cowboy Way! The boys hit the road to find the perfect bull for their herd, if Booger's backseat antics don't drive them all crazy first. They discover a cowboy candy store where a famous saddle maker fits Bubba's horse for a custom saddle. Cody gets challenged to a roping contest by some teenagers. And when they accidentally find themselves in the fanciest restaurant in town, the guys test their cowboy palate with fine French cuisine. Escargot anyone? Back home Jaclyn and Kaley try hot yoga for their first and maybe last time, and Misty takes a shine to modeling.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: A secretive woman coaxes two cowboys to take her across the desert. The woman keeps changing her mind about their destination. When she hires a gunslinger and begins tracking a rider ahead of them, the cowboys wonder what this lady is planning.

programme.title: Handcrafted America
programme.desc: Host Jill Wagner travels the country on a quest to find talented craftsmen who still make incredible items by hand. Denny Carson of Spokane, Washington, is a woodworker and catch-and-release fisherman who marries his two passions to make stone-studded fishing nets. Heath Van Den Bogaert is a stand up paddleboard maker in Deerfield Beach, Florida who shows Jill that his custom-made boards are not just for hitting the water during the daylight hours. In Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, furniture maker Peter Handler creates whimsical tables using local hardwoods and brightly colored aluminum in a process not usually used to make furniture.

programme.title: State Plate
programme.desc: From the sandy beaches to the...well, swampy swamps, host Taylor Hicks hits the road to The Sunshine State seeking out Florida's most popular and emblematic foods! With the help of iconic actress Maureen McCormick, Taylor uncovers the stories and legends behind the Sunshine State's traditional cuisine. Not only do they enjoy some tasty tidbits, but they also dive into some unique Florida experiences. Join Taylor as he learns how to harvest a local favorite called swamp cabbage, and Maureen heads out to sea to fish for stone crab. They also sample alligator bites and a Florida fruit that is almost as popular as the orange: the Kumquat. And, of course, they can't leave the great state of without indulging in Florida's a savory slice of key lime pie.

programme.title: Legends of the Stagecoach
programme.desc: A marvel of engineering, the iconic stagecoach becomes indispensable when Americans settle the West. As stagecoaches and their heroic drivers navigate perilous trails to transport passengers and valuables, they are easy targets for lawless bandits.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: For months, a thin wall of rock is all that keeps the peace between two rival silver mining companies 300 feet below the Idaho desert. When the barrier is finally breached, pickaxes give way to pistols and rifles, and the miners battle for five days.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After the suspicious death of a tunnel worker, and unconvincing answers from the project's lead engineer, Doc Susie goes on a covert mission to find out what happened. Deep underground, she finds her own life in peril when she's trapped by a cave-in.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: A young Jedediah Smith joins William Ashley's expedition and helps establish the fur trade along the Missouri River, but it's not hunting or trapping he longs for...it's adventure. Inspired by Lewis and Clark, he wants to explore the vast, uncharted American frontier. Trekking through unknown and unforgiving terrain, Smith's iron will and unwavering courage under fire help him survive a vicious grizzly bear attack, hostile Native Americans, and life-or-death periods of starvation, dehydration, and exhaustion. During his incredible journeys, he becomes the first non-Native American to cross the Mojave Desert into California, the first to navigate through the perilous Sierra Nevada Mountains, and the first to traverse the Great Basin Desert. He ultimately sees more of the American West than any other adventurer, including Lewis and Clark, and opens the frontier in a way that no other mountain man can claim.

programme.title: Ultimate Cowboy Showdown
programme.desc: With only eight cowboys left, the competition takes a dangerous turn as the contestants compete in a challenge with a raging bull to win the immunity belt buckle. During the team challenge a steer escapes, and while most of the contestants try to correct their mistake, a few of them sit on the sidelines instead of helping their fellow teammates. programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: Lethal Love Affair
programme.desc: Krystal Dunbar, is promoted as the youngest department head at her computer firm, after only four months. Loving her career, Krystal has convinced herself that her job is more important than a relationship. But, after an encounter with Zoey Kendricks, a beautiful and mysterious new arrival to town, Krystal's world is turned upside down. When their brief romance begins to conflict with Krystal's career aspirations, she quickly halts the relationship, sending Zoey’s emotions spiraling downward.

programme.title: Lot Lizards 2: Revenge Route
programme.desc: Destitute and desperate, China is forced to the edge, taking up work as a truck stop sex worker just to survive. Into this grim reality storms Ze, who has come to town seeking vengeance on Angie's sister—the woman who murdered his brother, Tez. But Ze's plans are bigger than just revenge: he aims to rally and recruit every woman working the highway.

programme.title: He'll Still Never Let Go
programme.desc: In the wake of her abusive ex-boyfriend Karlton's disappearance, Candace seeks a fresh start. Just as she begins to open her heart to new love, Brandon, his reckless actions inadvertently expose her to danger, unaware that Karlton is silently watching. With her past closing in and her safety at risk, Candace must confront her deepest fears and fight to reclaim her freedom before Karlton's sinister plans destroy her chance at happiness.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Black Game Night
programme.desc: A group of friends prepare to attend The Blacks’ annual game night, but make a chilling discovery when the arrive to find the hosts have been brutally murdered. In their pursuit to uncover the murderer, secrets unravel and betrayals are discovered, winning no longer becomes the goal – it’s surviving.

programme.title: Gimme the Loot
programme.desc: Big Poppa and Ms. Wallace own and operate their own gentleman’s club, “Gimme the Loot” that’s funded by their criminal earnings. Their revenue is partly earned by their exotic dancers they recruit, who double as their crew to execute heists and bank robberies. But when the new crew finds themselves entangled in a high-stakes world of loyalty, secrets, and danger, their loyalties will be tested, and the crew have to decide if “The Loot” is really worth it.

programme.title: The Kitty Hallow Killer
programme.desc: A serial killer is on the loose in Houston killing pedophiles and rapists. When Mason and Jessica get into a horrible car accident on their wedding day, Jessica wakes up with no memory of her life or even her husband. As her memories start to come back in pieces, she is afraid that her husband, Mason, could be The Kitty Hallow Killer.

programme.title: Nothing Even Matters
programme.desc: Paroled after 5 years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by an acquaintance, Benny, and her mother. Their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder. As he falls for a woman named Bear, Travis must escape the web of secrets and lies he's trapped in, fighting for survival and the love he's found.

programme.title: Angel and Demon
programme.desc: When sheltered college student Angel, the daughter of the police chief, falls for Romelle “Demon” Montez, the ruthless leader of the South Side Mobb, they instantly become star-crossed lovers. Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence and threatens Angel’s once promising future.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Vices

When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal
programme.desc: In St. Francisville, Louisiana lies the picturesque Myrtles Plantation. Situated 26 miles from Baton Rouge, it may not be the grandest of plantations, but what it lacks in presentation, it makes up for in disturbing history and lore. Owned by the Moss family, it’s touted as one of the most haunted places in America! Visitors have reported seeing apparitions, lights turning on and off, faces and handprints in mirrors, vanishing objects; hearing random footsteps, rattling doorknobs, children’s cries, and unexplained smells. The Myrtles Plantation has been featured on “Ghost Hunters,” “Ghost Adventures,” ”Unsolved Mysteries” and “Most Terrifying Places in America.”But is this plantation the paranormal hotspot it’s claimed to be? Does it hold the dark and tragic history of poisonings, hangings, mutilation, murder, and gunfire claimed? Can fact be separated from fiction? Ericka and her team are about to find out.

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal

programme.title: Second Sight Paranormal

programme.desc: Live from The Picklr in Noblesville, this NCPA Indiana Regional 2025 matchup features a critical battle between the University of Wisconsin-Madison and Purdue University. With eight national bids and $5,000 in prize money on the line, the stakes are high as the 16th-seeded Purdue takes on the 17th-seeded Wisconsin in a best-of-seven format.The match kicks off with Gender Doubles, where Wisconsin’s duo of Noah and Sarah Sowinski showcase dominant net play and quick hands against Purdue’s Caleb Yang and Trevor Ju. Watch for standout moments, including an incredible Ernie from Wisconsin and strategic adjustments in the Mixed Doubles games involving Colton Thielman and Elena Schlichte.

programme.title: Pickleball England
programme.desc: Experience the exciting Women's Doubles Open 4.5+ Final from the 2023 English Open held at Bolton Arena, Greater Manchester. This match features dynamic teams: Megan Fudge and Susannah Barr face off against Lee Whitwell and Riley Bohnert in a highly competitive final. Follow expert commentary highlighting key plays including Susannah Barr’s precise lobs, Megan Fudge’s powerful forehand, and strategic teamwork. See how the match unfolds in a best-of-three games format with a hard stop on time. This showcase of top-level English pickleball captures the skill, tactics, and intensity of the sport. Stay tuned for post-match insights and upcoming mixed doubles action.

programme.title: Court Kings
programme.desc: Get the behind-the-scenes look of the pickleball court construction process with the Court Kings crew Lonnie "Hurricane" Anger, Alex "Mufasa" Lanzetta, Paul "Gucci" Roschfska and Jerry "Cruise" Duncan.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League
programme.desc: This episode of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, features a redemption match between the Sarasota Manatees and the Lakeland Palms. Both teams are coming off a loss and are looking for a win in this intense doubles matchup. The Manatees jump out to an early lead, but the Palms, with strong play from players like Ava and Ashley Griffith, manage to crawl back into the game and make it a nail-biting finish. The episode features courtside commentary from Jay Carroll and Hugh Greene.

programme.title: The Wager
programme.desc: Jason Kennedy and Wes Burrows challenge Golden Tate and Eric Decker.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.desc: Watch as the formidable mother-daughter duo, Lee and Anna Leigh Waters, take on challengers from North Carolina in this Pro Women's Doubles match from the US National Pickleball Center. After an injury, it is great to see the champions partner up again, demonstrating the "fire and ice" style of play that has made them national champions. While the Waters team's game one was a quick 11-point victory, the challengers, Fuzesi and Maloof, handled themselves well on the championship court. The players at home can learn from Anna Leigh's "instigator" shots and two-handed backhand rolls, which she helped bring to the big stage.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Lee Whitwell and Andrei Daescu take on Stefan Andren and Alix Truong in this Mixed Pro Split Age Semifinal match.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.desc: Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. Mumbai ignites the home crowd with a dominant early lead, fueled by Jada Bui’s emotional victory over a "fearful" Katie Morris and a clinical masterclass from Brandon and Glauca Carvajal Lane in mixed doubles. However, the tide turns in a dramatic "tale of two halves" as Pune United mounts a stunning comeback. Witness the high-power precision of Bolin Bako as he derails Max Green’s momentum, sparking a relentless surge that sees Pune sweep the final three matches to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and Milan Rane take on Yana Newell and Yates Johnson in this Mixed Pro Doubles Backdraw Semifinal.

programme.title: NPL
programme.desc: The Coachella Valley Scorpions face off against the Denver Iconics in a mixed team match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023
programme.desc: In this high-stakes Bronze Medal match at the 2023 US Open Pickleball Championships, veteran competitors Jenny Klitch and Sheri Courter go head-to-head with Ellen Novoseletsky and Jenny Marcos. Expect calculated teamwork, steady hands, and sharp strategy as these seasoned senior pros compete for a podium finish. Filmed live from Naples, Florida, this match showcases the competitive spirit and skill that define senior pro pickleball.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Dylan Frazier and James Johnson take on Andrei Daescu and Gabriel Tardio in this Men's Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024
programme.desc: Sheri Courter and Mari Humberg take on Martina Frantova and Christine Karges in this Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal match at the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships. With fast-paced exchanges, sharp angles, and tactical precision, both teams battle for a spot in the finals on the prestigious Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida. This high-stakes match features standout teamwork and thrilling rallies from some of the sport’s most skilled competitors.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, concludes its first day with the historic Men's Singles Open Final under the floodlights. England's captain James Chaudry, the only active European player with a DUPR rating over 6.0, faces off against Poland's Bartosz Karbownik (referred to as Kabosnik/Kabashnik in audio).Chaudry dominates early with a mix of power and precise cross-court angles, taking the first game decisively. While Karbownik produces moments of brilliance, including a spectacular passing shot, he struggles with his footing on the clay surface. Witness Team England secure the gold medal in the inaugural singles event of the championships.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: October 4, 2022 - Live from The Orchard @ Jigsaw Health, it's Tuesday Night Pickleball

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: Witness one of the most exciting finals from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome. In the Women's Senior Singles Open Final, Team England’s Anna Linton takes on Team Italy’s Paola Tampieri at the iconic Stadio dei Marmi. Linton starts with commanding form, dominating the first game with powerful forehand drives. However, the momentum shifts as Tampieri, fueled by a passionate home crowd, adjusts her strategy to target Linton’s backhand and level the match.
